turns.text: Hi. I've been charged for something I didn't order. And honestly, I'm pretty fed up.
I'm sorry to hear that. Let me pull up your account. It's

2299. It came out on Monday. And that's not all. My order number is 4821. Wait. That's the old one. The current order is 4917, and it never showed up. I think I was also charged twice for it because my bank shows two payments. And there's an extra fee of $6 that I don't recognize. Like I said, I was charged for something I didn't order. I just want the wrong charge reversed and someone to tell me where my order is.
